fields.description:
After beating Cataclysm i got really hyped about the cape section and decided that i wanted more so i went further in cape mechanics and built this hack, this hack is the ultimate cape challenge a full pit hack featuring a lot of cape tricks since normal flight till the most deep pit of cape glitches.

This is a challenge made by me for myself, so we have 3 endings, if you don't wanna play the entire hack you can go for an any% run and for those who wanna a real challenge you can go for 100%, this is the first pit hack where you can decide your route, so open lunar magic, see all rooms, route your path and go for the TAS.

14 cape rooms, 3 bosses, some secrets and some extra challenges!

Hope you enjoy it and let's have fun!

Fixes 1.1
- 3 moons had problems so i fixed
- added a big door in room 102 to avoid useless damage boost
- added credits for the first 100% blind clear

fields.description:
Well, after a long time, The Pit Level 3 has been completed.

This hack was started in 2015 and I worked hard on it until mid-2017. For personal reasons, I was forced to interrupt progress and it was practically stopped until 2022. From 2022 onwards I managed to work hard on it again and finish it.

The focus of this hack was not difficulty, although it is somewhat complex. My goal was to make a fun hack. Because it was mostly made between 2015 and 2017, this hack is made up of many shelljumps, yumps, keyjumps and things like that. Nowadays, that's not as cool as it was in 2015, but I didn't have much of a choice. I managed to change many rooms and eliminate some repeated shelljumps, but overall if I were to change everything, I would have to do a new hack.

FULL HACK VIDEO: https://youtu.be/mrlO3VQiz9U

Anyway, that was the most I could do. Although this hack is full of shelljumps/keyjumps, it also has some cool tricks, as you will see in some rooms.

NOTE: The water room (room 112) is different from what appears in the video. I changed it because it was generating a lot of lag, but unfortunately I couldn't change it in the video, as the TAS was desyncing.

NOTE 2: The crash at the end of the video was for pure fun, it is not mandatory. The hack ends as soon as you kill the boss.

That's it, download and enjoy!

fields.description:
This is a romhack I began developing quite some time ago, and after a long stretch of on-and-off work, I'm finally getting around to completing it. It used to be said that my hack would be released around the same time as Mario Maker 3, so I'm happy to be releasing it ahead of schedule!

The central focus is on building unique challenges through custom ASM. I wrote many original sprites, blocks, mechanics, and gimmicks with each level typically revolving around one particular ASM creation. The design blends standard and kaizo elements, but generally offers freedom in how to approach obstacles, rather than forcing a single strict approach.

While the early levels are fairly approachable, the difficulty ramps up significantly as the hack progresses. Later stages present intense challenges, even for the best players, demanding skill much deeper than just raw execution. Progress may seem slow at times, but those who stick with it will hopefully find steady improvement, and a rewarding experience as proficiency grows, perception sharpens, and difficulty gives way to hard-earned intuition.

fields.description:
What started as a small idea for a “classic-style” Kaizo hack slowly turned into a personal revenge project — inspired by my time playing Responsible World.
But let’s be real: this isn’t about revenge (well… maybe a little). It’s more about seeing if I could still create something fresh in a scene where it feels like everything has already been done.

The result?
22 exits full of pain, frustration, and a complete disregard for your time. If you’re into old-school difficulty, this one’s for you.

Features:

No QoL patches (except for the framerule fix)

Kaizo blocks. Lots of them.

Checkpoints that don’t save (1-Ups, Dragon Coins — you know the drill)

Pure, unapologetic difficulty

Zero respect for human sanity

You’ve been warned.

Good luck.



Much thanks and appreciation towards the people helping me out shaping this project into what it is.

name: Mario's Misadventures 2: The Black Hole Bomb

fields.description:
Following from Mario's Misadventures: The Secret of The 11 Gems, Mario enters the black hole to stop the explosive device, discovering a strange new world inside. What is going on here? Where is the explosive device? As he explores the black hole, he starts to find clues about Bowser's whereabouts and a few artifacts from the Aquarians. Why did Bowser go to war with the Aquarians? Who else could he be working with? Can our hero locate and defuse the bomb before it goes off and destroys everything?

fields.description:
SMW Friends and Rivalry is a Super Mario World hack with traditional level design akin to the Mario games made by Nintendo.

Here's a trailer for what to expect of the hack:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K27NsqRDHUQ

It features 90+ new levels and 118 exits across 9 worlds.
Also a lot of new stuff have been added to make this hack feel like a new and grand adventure like new moves for Mario, custom sprites, custom music, graphics, lots of quality of life improvements to the gameplay like faster P-baloon and fast swiming and much more.

Story:
Mario and his friends were preparing for a party on Jamboree island, a resort paradise by the sea.
However Kamek comes out of nowhere and hipnotize everyone while Mario was out on the market buying some drinks for the party, now Mario must go on an adventure where he will have to face his turned-evil hipnotized friends to rescue them from the spell and defeat Kamek

The hack is available in English and Brazilian Portuguese translations and there are also 2 .bps patches included that allows you to play a slighty harder version of the game if you want to challenge yourself.

I hope you enjoy the new adventure with Mario and his friends!
-Bandicoot

fields.description:
After years of work left incomplete due to perfectionism, I've finally lowered my standards enough to finish a demo of a romhack! I don't recommend waiting for the full version; this took over a year and I may have overcommitted!

This hack features:
- Multiple custom bosses
- Multiple player characters
- Multiple weird orders in which to complete levels
- Multiple enemies intentionally designed to be sort of annoying
- Multiple levels taking place on mountains
- (probably) Multiple bugs which will require me to re-submit the demo at least once

Update (2025-12-26): fixed some oversights (thanks Ringo), replaced Nintendo Presents screen

name: A Second X Thing: Gaiden: Gaiden

fields.description:
Christmas is quickly approaching and Demo's in search of a sleigh-- help her find one pronto!

This is an Advent Calendar in SMW form created by the talkhaus community (who previously worked on And Another Thing, which you should check out as well!) as a surprise for raocow this year, and can be seen as a successor to the earlier SMBX-related ones. Each level is its own individual "present" ranging from small gags to tough challenges to puzzles and everything in-between. While it contains a plethora of talkhaus and raocow-related humor and in-jokes, knowledge of any of them are not required in order to complete the hack.

The version submitted here to SMWC is slightly different from the version raocow received for the holidays-- collectable coins save at midways/goals and display on the overworld, and various levels have received small QoL changes. Beyond that, the experience should be basically identical.

We hope you enjoy playing this as much as we had making this!

fields.description:
Uncharted World is a hack focused on challenging platforming. Most levels were designed to encourage improvisational gameplay, containing obstacles that can be completed in multiple ways. As a change of pace, you will also find some levels with more linear obstacle design as well as some more puzzling levels.

There is an open-ended overworld, with many possible routes to reach the credits. Although there are 63 exits in total, you can reach the credits in about 30 - 35 exits. Naturally, there is lot of additional content to play for those who are interested.

The hack has quality of life features (such as fast retry, infinite lives, autosave, and bug fixes) as well as custom music.

Have fun!

name: Super Mario's Wacky Worlds SD Happy new Year 2026!!

fields.description:
!warning this hack may contain scenarios that cause nausea and photosensitivity!

IMPORTANT: This hack uses the MSU-1 and Sa-1 chip, so not all emulators will work correctly. Recommended emulators are snes9x, bsnes, higan (not sure if I spelled higan correctly)


!Compile Instructions!

Step (1): Download the MSU-1 music zip file from this link: [url]https:https://drive.google.com/file/d/1kbKnnGsZev8w6XJQNsup9a7TpmpHsNcH/view?usp=drive_link

Otherwise, the game may have no sound or play super mario world music.

(Note that this file is 700MB in memory because of the pcm audios, a standard in hacks that use the MSU-1 chip).


Step(2): After downloading the zip file, extract it and move the Super Mario's Wacky Worlds SD.smc hack to the SMWWSD folder along with the .pcm and .msu files
